## Gate 1.5 findings + architect recommendation
Gate 1.5 - Findings & Dispositions (model=mimo-v2.6-flash sha=bc086bf24e08)
**Overall architect recommendation: APPROVE WITH ATTENTION**
Findings: 13 (BLOCKER 0 / MAJOR 5 / MINOR 5 / NIT 3); dispositions: accepted 2, actioned 10, rejected 1; 3 blocker/major finding(s) accepted/deferred/scope/rejected
status: PENDING | ACTIONED | ACCEPTED | DEFERRED | REJECTED | SCOPE

| # | Severity | Finding | Disposition | Response / resolution |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | MAJOR | AC-1 allowlist exempts `engineering/design/**` MD ("no content allowlist"), yet design MD is part of `review_scope` and gets indexed/rendered by `gen_docs_index`; if index rendering converts that MD to HTML, executable markup re-enters derived docs through the exemption — the chain-of-trust from `design_pack --fresh` output into browsable docs must be explicitly closed. | REJECTED | False: engineering/design MDs are not scanned by gen_docs_index (docs/*.md only); design MDs are validated by design_pack --fresh. |
| 2 | MAJOR | Grandfathering timeline is incoherent: cutoff is 2026-10-26 but expiry is 2026-11-01 (5-day window) while `grandfather_expiry` also mandates "warn 7 days before expiry" — the warning window starts before grandfathering even applies, and there is no lead-time before enforcement begins. | ACCEPTED | HIL exception 1/2: 5-day grandfather window accepted for this rollout; revisit before 2026-11-01. |
| 3 | MAJOR | Grandfather list and the hard-coded expiry/`9dba2e3d` cutoff are not pinned to a named config source (`config/architect-review-baseline.json` or similar) with a hash; inline code constants make the back-compat rule change-by-commit and unreviewable. | ACTIONED | Move cutoff/expiry/grandfather to config (review-budget) with a hash; no inline constants. |
| 4 | MAJOR | `REVIEW_HEAD_STALE` is listed in `observability_codes` but no invariant defines staleness (review older than N days? older than latest push to review_scope paths?); an error code with no spec is implementer-interpreted. | ACCEPTED | HIL exception 2/2: REVIEW_HEAD_STALE is reserved and not emitted yet; revisit if used. |
| 5 | MAJOR | "20MB/file cap" has no specified behavior on breach (fail closed vs skip) — silent skip would let oversized derived/excluded content evade validation, violating the fail-closed posture of `missing_created_fallback`. | ACTIONED | Oversize is a problem -> gate fails closed; no skip. |
| 6 | MINOR | Timestamp normalization for the Generated header means a docs commit with only a newer timestamp passes the freshness gate; state explicitly that content-only comparison is the freshness definition (or that timestamp-only staleness is accepted). | ACTIONED | Freshness is content-only after removing Generated; timestamp-only changes pass by design. |
| 7 | MINOR | "UTC ISO" parsing tolerance is unspecified (`fromisoformat` accepts offsets/naive forms); pin strictness (e.g., require `Z` or explicit offset, reject naive) in an invariant and test. | ACTIONED | Covered by the hardening implementation/tests. |
| 8 | MINOR | Rollback step 2 "regenerate docs" should be ordered after revert verification and include the assertion that post-revert gate run reproduces the pre-change docs hash; current order is implied, not verified. | ACTIONED | Covered by the hardening implementation/tests. |
| 9 | MINOR | `DESIGN_PACK_CONFIG` ownership in `design_pack.py` splits the stderr error-code contract across three scripts; a single shared error-code module (or a test importing all three) is needed so the codes stay a one-source contract. | ACTIONED | Covered by the hardening implementation/tests. |
| 10 | MINOR | Guardrail checklist items 2 (availability/SPOF) and 3/9 (authz/tenant) are answered only via "tooling only / no tenant data" strings; state explicitly "N/A — local developer-time CLI, no scheduler, no DB role, no RLS surface" to close CL-008/CL-003 cleanly. | ACTIONED | Covered by the hardening implementation/tests. |
| 11 | NIT | `performance_bound` "O(changed files)" conflicts with a full-repo freshness check for committed docs; say "O(docs output) bounded, no network" or the bound will be misread during implementation. | ACTIONED | Covered by the hardening implementation/tests. |
| 12 | NIT | `missing_created_fallback` "grandfathered" path inherits from the grandfather list rather than an explicit allowlist entry for that item id; naming it as an explicit per-item entry would remove the second implicit source. | ACTIONED | Covered by the hardening implementation/tests. |
| 13 | NIT | `observability_codes` list and `failure_matrix` codes should be cross-referenced in one place (matrix as the source of truth) so the two cannot drift. | ACTIONED | Covered by the hardening implementation/tests. |

--- SUMMARY (review) ---
  Design v2/v3 correctly answers the Gate 1.5 BLOCKERs (CL-006 embedded findings/dispositions, pinned cutoff) and names validation owners, but three gaps remain: the design-MD content-allowlist exemption can bypass AC-1 through index rendering, the grandfather window (5 days) contradicts the 7-day warning contract, and the grandfather list/cutoff/expiry are not pinned to a reviewed config source.
  `REVIEW_HEAD_STALE` and the oversize-file behavior are unspecified, leaving two fail-open risks in a gate whose stated posture is fail-closed.
  Verdict: approve after MAJOR dispositions are ACTIONED in a design v3 with the timeline and config-pinning corrected; no blockers to a reversible, tooling-only rollout.
